t.why: It disagrees with Tanzania over the boundary on Lake Malawi.
t.rel: A landlocked country surrounded by Mozambique, Tanzania and Zambia. It brings in goods through Mozambican ports, and many of its people go to work in South Africa and other neighbors.
t.know: Lake Malawi holds hundreds of fish species found nowhere else.
t.etext: Tobacco makes up most exports. Most people live from farming, and droughts are frequent.
